title: Unit Event — Dear Me, From Back Then — Episode3 ASRUN Show Prep Seminar!

meta.Event Outline: The time has finally arrived for the first solo show of MORE MORE JUMP! Minori still can't seem to shake her nerves, but is reminded of the time she saw an ASRUN show for the first time after Haruka tells Minori a story about her own past...

rows.Line: Holiday
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In preparation for their next show, Chihiro, I will be giving you a special lecture about ASRUN!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: We're just going to see them perform, right? Is this really necessary?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, it is!
These shows are way more fun when you know their songs, cheers and dance routines!!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess you have a point.
I do want to enjoy it as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Also, it'll give me an opportunity to learn more about dancing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! Since we're both going, we should try to get the most out of this show!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now, let's get down to business!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
First...
We'll begin with how ASRUN came to be!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
We're starting there?!
Shouldn't I be learning about their dances and how to cheer?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it'll be more fun if you learn about their roots...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, actually! We can talk about how to interpret their songs! Apparently, their newest song, “Maidenly Honey Mustard” is supposed to be about...!!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: No, you're missing my point...
Several tens of minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey! Hey!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Hey... Hey...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Chi, you gotta put more effort into it! Haruka and the others won't feel your energy if you don't!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: I know, but this is more embarrassing than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's more fun if you just go with the flow! Oh, like this part! Ready?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Chihiro
rows.Line: Lovey-dovey honey!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, that was great!
I knew a dancer like you would get the choreography in no time!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: I don't normally do these kinds of dances though...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: But the part for the chorus is pretty fun. Compared to the rest of the routine, it seems a lot easier. I think they made it that way so everyone else can dance along.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, you might be right...!
I never really thought about it that way, but that makes a lot of sense! It's easy for anyone to learn!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but when you become a veteran fan like me, you learn to master the other parts too!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Yeah, you are pretty good at copying these kinds of dance routines, Minori. You're usually the fastest to learn new moves during dance classes too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I've gotta be good at that since my goal's to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I already learned the dance routine for ASRUN's new song, so if I can do it during the show...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line:
Look at her! She's incredible!
We released this song just the other day, but she's already mastered it!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line:
You're dancing like an idol!
Have you signed with an agency already?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, no!
I'm still just an amateur who's trying to become an idol...
Um, excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haruka...?!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The dance routine for “Maidenly Honey Mustard” isn't an easy one. I'm very impressed by how you've mastered it already.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And you're trying to become an idol, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
You're my hero, Haruka! I want to become an idol just like you...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: ASRUN is actually looking for new members. If someone like you were to join us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm so glad we found you.
Would you like to join us? Join me as a member of ASRUN?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-What...?!
A-Are you sure...?!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line:
Whoa!
She became a member just like that!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line: I'm definitely gonna become your fan! I'll never forget what happened here today!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line: Minori! Minori! Minori! Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
If Haruka ever said anything like that to me...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
Um...
Please promise to not dance while we're at our seats the day of, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course, I won't!
I mean, I'd be bothering the people sitting around us if I suddenly started dancing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But what if...? Just what if...that opportunity comes!?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hehehehe. I can't wait to see their show♪)
The day of the show
Show Venue

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-We're finally here...!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
Yeah...
These venues really are enormous. It's so hard to tell just based on video footage.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?! I've watched that DVD a million times, but seeing it in real life feels so different...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: And I'm glad we get to watch sort of close to the front. I was worried that we wouldn't be able to see the stage very well if we were all the way at the back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I can see why some people bring binoculars. I'll have to keep that in mind for next time!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Binoculars would definitely help. The people over there on the second deck are carrying some too. But they aren't that far from the stage...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Actually, now that I've taken a look around, most everyone here has their own glow sticks. They're pretty much all wearing ASRUN T-shirts too...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: I guess that's normal since everybody here's an ASRUN fan...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
They're a super popular group and have tons of fans, but it really is an incredible sight...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: This place sounds so amazing when you put it that way... Don't I seem a bit out of place?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, not at all!
You learned their dances and even how to cheer, Chi! You're a full-fledged ASRUN fan now!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: I'm still not sure if “fan” is the right word for me...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: But I did buy some merch, so I guess I do sort of belong here now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's great how you got your allowance early too! You're all set now that you have your towel and glow sticks! All that's left is to cheer for Haruka and everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is so exciting...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So exciting that I'm starting to feel kind of sick...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I think I know what you mean. It's not like we're going to be on stage either...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Being on stage...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Right. It's completely normal for idols... It's normal for Haruka to stand on big stages like this one...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And that stage is...)

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line: Where do you think Haruka's enter from? Also, what do you think their set list's gonna be like?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line: I've gotta think they're gonna open or close the show with Honey Mustard! I'm not gonna miss a second of it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(So much anticipation...
The show hasn't even started yet, but everyone sounds really excited.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(And pretty soon...
Even more people are going to be gazing at the stage as Haruka puts on another perfect performance...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If I somehow become an idol...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line: The dance for the new song looks pretty hard. Do you think they'll be able to do it okay live?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line:
Yeah, I mean, they have to!
Especially Haruka! She'll definitely dance it perfectly!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line: What do you think she's gonna sing today? I really hope she does all of my favorites...!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line: All might be a bit tough, but I'm sure she'll sing a few of them.

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line:
Aww, it would've been so good if she could sing all of them...
Even so, I can't wait to see her perform! I'm gonna sing along with her!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If I become an idol... Can I handle all of this...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(There's like 50,000 people here...
That's so many... And they're all watching really closely...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Even if by some miracle I was able to become a member of ASRUN... Even if I were allowed to be on stage...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Can I put on a perfect performance like Haruka...? I'm not sure I could...)

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Huh? Does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It's starting...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here's our first song!
